specialEventConditions.title: CHRISTMAS AND NEW YEAR
specialEventConditions.description:
Hello Guests. Please note that a 30-day cancellation policy applies for all bookings between December 20th, 2025 to January 10th, 2026.
A 25% deposit is required at the time of booking and full payment is due one month before arrival. No refunds or changes are allowed within 30 days of check-in.
Thank you for your attention and we hope you enjoy stay!

freeCancellation.label: Free Cancellation rates
freeCancellation.description: If you cancel your booking before 23:59 21st Dec 2025 (AEDT) your deposit will be refunded to your payment card. If you cancel after 23:59 21st Dec 2025 (AEDT) or in the event of a no-show, your deposit will not be refunded and the total of the first night's accommodation will be charged to your payment card, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information). Please note that cancellations must be made directly within your booking in My Account.
